extracted.name: Banana Walnuts Muffins
extracted.description: I got this recipe from YouTube as well. Just sharing.
instruction_lines: Mix dry ingredients and wet ingredients on separate mixing bowls.
AGAIN: Don't over mix it to maintain the fluffiness. Some adds cornstarch so it will be chewy, but it's up to you. 1 tsp of cornstarch is optional.
Prepare them in your baking pans. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes. 350 degrees F.
